scope: proposal + teacher prototype + current GitHub product

requirements.requirement: Cross-fitted orthogonal DML/AIPW ATE with recorded learner and fold structure.
Report ATE estimate, standard error, and confidence interval.
Report DML-ATE beside the difference in means and a conventional covariate-adjusted estimate.
requirements.evidence: The public workflow and result schema report naive difference-in-means and all-covariate constant-effect OLS with HC3 uncertainty beside DML/AIPW. The separate nine-form comparison reports evaluator-side bias, RMSE, and coverage.

requirements.requirement: Compare TRAIN cross-fitted DML ATE with the final orthogonal reconstructed CATE standardized to the same TRAIN target distribution; interrupt downstream interpretation when the absolute gap exceeds 0.10 SD(Y_train).
requirements.evidence: The hash-frozen rule passed 10/10 fresh cells and is config-driven in the public schema/runtime; failure overrides downstream support with INCONCLUSIVE.
requirements.required_action: None. Preserve 0.05 and 0.15 as sensitivity values only.

requirements.requirement: Treatment validity, positivity/overlap, and data-contract diagnostics must be executable gates before morphology.
requirements.evidence: The public runtime evaluates binary treatment, treatment prevalence, OOF propensity tails, and clipping before invoking the unified morphology workflow; failure writes DESIGN_NOT_ELIGIBLE and skips the forest.
requirements.required_action: None. Thresholds remain explicit in configs/public_workflow_contract_v1.json.
